== Original post ==

'''TIE Interceptor are in Fighter Cover'''
* '''Author:''' Ronald "LojeNella" Rullens
* '''Published:''' August 3, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' TIE Interceptor with force Retrieval

=== Strategy ===

Just Drain as fast as you can and fight with Vader the weak spots of your opponnent.

U-3PO is in here to block an drain; SFS and Wakeelmui for retrieval; Cmndr. Merrejk to get your system; Baron for kicking hard in space;

And you now the rest..

Enjoy

Update 08.08.2000

Made some changes

-There was 1 card to many in this deck. (Removed 1 TIE interceptor too make this dek 60 cards). -Removed Baron and Saber 1 and added a TIE Interceptor and Ghkkk
